faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to common questions about admissions, fees, study gaps, and visas.
faq.q1: Can I study abroad without IELTS?
faq.a1: Yes, absolutely! Countries like Malaysia accept Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificates from Bangladeshi universities and colleges. Several UK and European universities also offer internal English tests or accept Duolingo English Test (DET).
faq.q2: How many years of study gap are acceptable?
faq.a2: For Malaysia, study gaps of up to 5-10+ years are accepted with justifiable work or business experience. For the UK and Canada, gaps with continuous employment documents or skill certifications are readily accepted.
faq.q3: Does ISL Global charge any file opening fees?
faq.a3: No. ISL Global Education does not charge any upfront file opening fee. Initial profile evaluation, university matching, and guidance are completely free.
faq.q4: How long does the entire visa process usually take?
faq.a4: For Malaysia, admission and EMGS eVAL approval typically takes 3 to 6 weeks. For the UK, the process takes approximately 4 to 8 weeks depending on the intake and visa priority service chosen.
faq.q5: Can I work part-time while studying abroad?
faq.a5: Yes. Most major destinations allow international students to work 20 hours per week during term time and full-time during semester breaks, helping support living expenses.
